acceptance: Use a compact right-edge action rail, compact top-right read-only status stack and separated bottom-center shortcuts.

At most one large feature panel is open at a time.
Panel fits inside the current device safe area, remains dismissible, and does not leave feature actions stranded off-screen.

Responsive blue panel preserves grid/tile browsing, preview/details, price and server-read balances.
